name: Ansible (AAP EE)
postCreateCommand: set -e; mkdir -p /root/.ssh; chmod 700 /root/.ssh; cp /tmp/ssh_config_host /root/.ssh/config; cp /tmp/lab_rsa_host /root/.ssh/lab_rsa; chmod 600 /root/.ssh/config /root/.ssh/lab_rsa; chown -R root:root /root/.ssh; rm -f /tmp/ssh_config_host /tmp/lab_rsa_host || true
